story:
Before the burning there was a hall of disputation in the eastern part of the isle, where the colleges of Avalon sent their readers to argue, and a reader called Kelsanor kept it: a small, sharp man who could hold every side of an argument in his head at once and speak each in its own voice. On the night of the burning the readers who argued there died in it, and Kelsanor, the Inconnu of Wearyall say, did what he had always done. He kept every voice.

He is in the ruins still, past the lone tree on the hill, and he speaks in many voices, all of them the dead readers', all arguing, and Marden in Wearyall village hears them in his sleep and cannot make them stop. The dread disciples who stand round him are what came to listen and could not leave. Karayan, who has dealings with Arawn's people, says the lord of the dead wants those voices, and wants Kelsanor's essence brought to him so that they can be let go.

The old folk of the village say that once, when he was hurt, Kelsanor would throw the one who hurt him clean out of his sight, as a reader throws an opponent out of the argument. Nobody now living has seen him do it. The voices have grown louder instead.
legend: Kelsanor, level 42 ghost, in the ruins east past the lone tree on the hill east of Wearyall, with about fifteen dread disciples (38) around him. Clear the disciples first; they are close and aggressive. The Voices of the Dead quest text says he warps you away at low health: on this server he does not, he is plain melee with no spells. Take his essence to Karayan. Respawn is fast (80 seconds), so loot and go.

aggro: Speak, then. We will all answer.

lairEntry: Many voices, one ghost, all arguing.
atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Kelsanor has fallen. The voices are let go.
